verify_reasons: The sourced ALDOT document covers only Superload requirements; it does not publish the sub-superload escort matrix (e.g. 1-pilot vs 2-pilot width thresholds below 16'). Confirm ordinary oversize escort thresholds with the ALDOT permit office.
Single-trip permit fee is not in the Superload document; confirm the fee schedule with ALDOT.
Legal dimension limits (8'6" wide, 13'6" high, 53' semitrailer, 80,000 lbs) are statutory defaults not stated in the Superload document.

superload_thresholds.note: ALDOT superload = any load exceeding 16' wide, 16' high, 150' long, or 300,000 lbs gross. Requires justification letter, load/axle drawings, Special Work Authorization for bridge analysis (weight), and a route survey. Utility notification/bucket truck required over 16'5"-16'6" high.

width.note: superload: minimum of two State Trooper/Police escorts; additional troopers may be required (ALEA schedules after permit pre-approval)

height.note: superload height; bucket truck required over 16'5", utility notification over 16'6"; 2 police escorts

length.note: superload length; minimum 2 State Trooper/Police escorts

single_trip.note: Fee not stated in the sourced ALDOT Superload document — confirm single-trip permit fee with the ALDOT permit office. Superload weight moves require a Special Work Authorization (SWA) and bridge analysis.

annual.note: Annual/blanket options not covered by the sourced Superload document; confirm with ALDOT.

movement_restrictions: Most superloads must travel between 9:00 PM and 6:00 AM Sunday through Thursday, unless approved otherwise by the permit office
Superloads require a lighting plan with flashing amber/strobe lights on all extremities
City or County Engineer approval required for superloads on city streets or county roads
notes: Only ALDOT's Superload requirements sheet was available as source text; ordinary (sub-superload) oversize/overweight limits, escort tiers, and fees are not captured here and are flagged for verification.
